d: Brazil heads into a presidential run-off election on October 25, with incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva facing Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro. Firstpost examines the candidates’ policies, the close race and what the outcome could mean for Brazil’s relations with the US, China and BRICS. Meanwhile, Iran has unveiled an underground drone factory displaying hundreds of drones, including a mysterious black, two-tailed model identified as the new Arash-3. Tehran claims the drone will be more lethal than the Arash-2, previously used in attacks across the Gulf.…
